stem: Which sentences best help to create suspense in the story?

options.label: A
options.text: “They’d come to $3.22,” she reported. “Shall I ring them up for you?”

options.label: B
options.text: I hurried to the school supply section. The pencils were gone.

options.label: C
options.text: I looked toward the counter. She held up a set of the pencils.

options.label: D
options.text: I dumped the coins out onto the counter. “Just right,” she announced.
